evals.prompt: We're launching a free online education program for adults with insomnia in the US and Germany, run with a patient community. Our product is an FDA-cleared CBT-I app (K191716 is the 510(k)) and we also have a DiGA-listed version in Germany. Draft leaflet lines: 'Clinically proven to cure insomnia', 'Join thousands who sleep better without pills', and a quote from a member: 'This app gave me my life back.' Write the program purpose and activities and tell us what the leaflet can say.

We're a UK digital health company bound by the ABPI Code. We want to sponsor a national arthritis charity's patient newsletter for 12 months and have them co-write a page about our app. They'd also nominate two members for a NICE committee on our product area. What should the agreement say and what do we have to disclose?

Our US remote-monitoring app is used by Medicare patients. We want to give each enrolled patient a $50 gift card at sign-up and lend a basic tablet to patients without a smartphone. Is this OK under the patient engagement safe harbor? Our compliance lead is Ravi.

Write a one-paragraph statement for our website and for the patient group we fund saying our $600 device-loan program is fully covered by the OIG safe harbor and that the group independently endorses our app.
